name: claude-trading-skills
description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
one_liner: A pack of ready-made Claude 'skills' that do stock research for you — pulling charts, screening stocks, and checking an economic calendar — built for individual investors who trade on the side.
buyer: A working professional who manages their own long-term-plus-swing-trading portfolio in spare time and wants Claude to handle the screening and charting legwork without learning finance APIs.
business_use_cases: An individual investor installs the skill pack so Claude can screen for swing-trade setups and summarize earnings calendars during a lunch break instead of a full research session.
A finance newsletter writer uses the screener skill to find candidate stocks to write about each week, cutting research time.
An investing-course creator bundles these skills as a 'starter kit' for students learning to combine AI tools with a disciplined trading process.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a premium skill pack with more data sources, screeners, and a community channel
Offer a paid setup service where buyers get it configured with their own broker or data API

steal_this: Package it with a short 'how to run this safely' guide and sell it as a one-time kit to retail-trading communities this weekend — the hard engineering work is already done.
